spans.s:
यियक्षमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Purposing or wishing to worship.
 E. यज् to
worship, desid. v., शानच् aff.

यियक्षु mfn. (-क्षुः-क्षुः-क्षु) Desirous of sacrificing.
 E. यज् to worship, desid. v., उ aff.

यियविषा f. (-षा) Wish to mix, blend, &c.
 E. यु to mix, desid. v., अङ् and
टाप् affs.

यियविषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Wishing to mix or blend.
 E. यु to mix, desid. v., उ aff.
